rows.grounds: instrumental pronoun fused with demonstrative by sandhi
object all with present active verb in one fused token

items.question: What does the accomplished goddess grant when the mantra is recited a thousand times?
premises: the accomplished one acts by that mantra
all is granted as the result
items.inference: A thousandfold recitation of that mantra makes the accomplished goddess grant everything.
uncertainties: whether tenāsau refers to the mantra, goddess, or practitioner
whether siddhā is feminine agent or accomplished state
items.plain_english: By that, she, accomplished, grants all a thousand times.
